newsitem.title: USA: Offshore to acquire Bristow stake.
newsitem.headline: Offshore to acquire Bristow stake.

text.p: Offshore Logistics Inc said on Friday that Caledonia Investments Plc, a major shareholder in Bristow Helicopter Group Ltd, agreed to become a significant shareholder in Offshore.
Under the terms of the deal, Caledonia will reduce its stake in Bristow, Offshore said.
The amount of a stake Caledonia will receive was not immediately available.
Offshore previously announced a tentative deal to acquire up to 50 percent of Bristow Helicopter's stock in a stock, debt and cash deal valuing Bristow at $300 million.

Offshore said this deal with Bristow, which was approved by the British Civil Aviation Authority, would have led to pro forma earnings per share of $0.80 for the year ended June 30, 1996, compared with the $0.77 a share Offshore reported on a stand-alone basis.
